title: KCP artifact_upload_show result (DESIGN.md §10.10, §11.6.1 read family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for artifact_upload_show (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). The visible ArtifactUpload projection (gap notes KG4/KG29); never a credential (§10.10).

staging_storage_ref.description: Recorded staging key reference (§10.10); a durable reference, never a credential — credentials come only from the separate artifact_upload_credential query (gap note KG29).

idempotency_key.description: The upload's committed idempotency key (§10.10 record field); scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm (§11.2).

artifactUpload.description: ArtifactUpload projection, field names verbatim from the §10.10 record shape (gap notes KG4/KG29). ETag and client metadata are not verification (§10.10).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

mediaType.description: RFC 6838 type/subtype token pair (media_type/declared_media_type); parameters are not carried in these fields — recorded extraction bound (gap note KG21/KG29).

rawSha256.description: Ordinary raw SHA-256 content checksum (raw_sha256/declared_raw_sha256, §10.10) for integrity and content-addressing; a different field type from the §11.8 typed digests, never interchangeable with them even when the 32-byte values match (§11.8).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
